The main positive evidence is limited to formal succession and some institutional continuity, not an overall improvement in democratic resilience.","evidence":[{"title":"Analysis-A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/","summary":"Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left behind strong growth and infrastructure, but also patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity than when he entered office. It also flagged the 2023 court ruling that enabled Gibran’s candidacy as a serious institutional warning sign. This supports a finding that Jokowi left the system less resilient than a clean inheritance would imply.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.7","4B.8"]},{"title":"Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024","summary":"The report says Kominfo could directly restrict content without appeals, election-period monitoring targeted “hoax” content, and critics/journalists/internet users faced prosecution, harassment, and self-censorship. That is strong evidence that democratic resilience in the information sphere weakened under Jokowi rather than strengthening.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.6","4B.9"]},{"title":"2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Indonesia","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2025-08-12; covers 2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128570.html","summary":"The report says there were no significant human-rights changes in 2024 and documents serious restrictions on freedom of expression and media freedom, plus weak accountability for abuses. This is the strongest positive evidence in the set: the constitutional handover occurred on schedule, so the formal succession rule survived even if the broader democratic environment worsened.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.8"]},{"title":"Indonesia court rejects election disputes, upholding president-elect Prabowo’s win","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-disputes-upholding-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051390/","summary":"The Constitutional Court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling and that state bodies had not been mobilized to sway the vote.
